posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is plotting her OTT comeback for 2027 after welcoming son Vihaan with Vicky Kaushal. She's reportedly reading scripts and in no rush — but the return is coming.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Sardaar Ji 3 won't release in India due to the Hania Aamir controversy. Meanwhile, Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga drops June 12 and he just paid tribute to Punjabi legends at the MSG.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser just dropped — Alia leads YRF's Spy Universe as its first female protagonist alongside Sharvari. The film hits theatres July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 and just named Rolex's global brand ambassador. PC continues her Varanasi shoot with SS Rajamouli.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King's title teaser crossed 90M+ views in 24 hours — the most for any Bollywood film. SRK's Christmas 2026 release is confirmed. Ranked #2 most valuable celebrity in India.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena spoke out on the Peddi objectification controversy and is in advanced talks for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film — a blockbuster reunion in the making.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha locks a Raksha Bandhan release on August 28! Shraddha plays legendary Lavani performer Vithabai Narayangaonkar in what's shaping up to be her most dramatic role yet.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting her second baby with Ranveer Singh and was spotted at their new Bandra home. She's also joined Allu Arjun in Atlee's next film AA22xA6 (Raka).

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 has grossed ~₹1800 Cr worldwide, making it a historic franchise. Ranveer's next film Pralay begins shooting in August, and Dhurandhar is heading to Japan.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stays characteristically private, but fans continue to speculate about her next film project as she remains one of India's most-followed stars globally.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 releases June 19 and topped IMDb's most-anticipated list. Rashmika is also in talks for an MS Subbulakshmi biopic — she just completed a look test.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram shifted to June 19 — Samantha's action sequences in a saree have fans buzzing. She's firmly back in the spotlight after her health hiatus.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's brand value is at an all-time high. He praised cousin Ram Charan's Peddi and confirmed AA22xA6 with Atlee — adding Deepika Padukone to the cast.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹250 Cr worldwide in its opening week. Ram Charan watched the film with fans in Hyderabad as the objectification debate swirls around the movie.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon keeps getting bigger — Anil Kapoor joins as the villain in Prashanth Neel's action epic. Release pushed to late 2026 and War 2 is confirmed for IMAX.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi faces objectification criticism over Peddi but has Lag Ja Gale announced for May 2027 and is reportedly approached for the Tumbbad director's creature horror.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Spotted with Sushmita Sen and Radhika Apte on set with Shoojit Sircar — a mystery project nobody saw coming. Chand Mera Dil has crossed ₹30 Cr at the box office.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara wished Toxic director Geetu Mohandas a happy birthday and shut down rumors about discomfort with bold scenes. Toxic with Yash is still awaiting a release date.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 underperformed domestically but Hrithik praised Jr NTR's performance. Up next: the Alpha teaser links him back into YRF's Spy Universe.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5 — David Dhawan's final directorial. Varun teases his next project will be 'very different' from anything he's done.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announces her Unstoppable Tour US dates for September 2026 — multiple cities confirmed. NRI fans are already scrambling for tickets.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman made history with his first-ever live performance at the Attari Border for the Main Vaapas Aaunga music launch with Imtiaz Ali — performing Maa Tujhe Salaam at the wagah.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jana Nayagan distribution deals are being reworked as Vijay's first film since becoming Tamil Nadu Chief Minister faces release uncertainty — likely pushed to July or later.
